Rime: Alacritty settings carried over to Ghostty


Carried over:
  font.normal.family = "Fira Code"
    -> font-family = Fira Code
  font.size = 12.5
    -> font-size = 12.5
  colors.primary.background = "0x002b36"
    -> background = #002b36
  colors.primary.foreground = "0x839496"
    -> foreground = #839496
  colors.normal.red = "0xdc322f"
    -> palette = 1=#dc322f
  colors.draw_bold_text_with_bright_colors = True
    -> bold-color = bright
  window.padding.x = 4
    -> window-padding-x = 3
  window.padding.y = 4
    -> window-padding-y = 3
  window.opacity = 0.85
    -> background-opacity = 0.85
  cursor.style.shape = "Underline"
    -> cursor-style = underline
  cursor.style.blinking = "Always"
    -> cursor-style-blink = true
  general.working_directory = "/home/alex/src"
    -> working-directory = /home/alex/src
  terminal.shell = {'program': '/run/current-system/sw/bin/bash', 'args': ['--login']}
    -> command = direct:/run/current-system/sw/bin/bash --login
  keyboard.bindings[0] key='Return' mods='Shift' chars='\x1b\r'
    -> keybind = shift+enter=text:\x1b\r
  keyboard.bindings[1] key='Back' mods='Alt' chars='\x1b\x7f'
    -> keybind = alt+backspace=text:\x1b\x7f
  keyboard.bindings[2] key='Key1' mods='Control' action='Copy'
    -> keybind = ctrl+1=copy_to_clipboard

Same as Rime's default, so not copied:
  colors.normal.black = "0x181818"

Not carried over:
  mouse.bindings[0] mouse='Right' action='PasteSelection'
    mouse bindings have no Ghostty equivalent
  alt_send_esc = False
    Ghostty sends Esc for Alt on Linux

Alacritty is still installed and its files were not changed.
